description: The Department of Veterans Affairs, Charlie Norwood VA Medical Center, Podiatry service line, located at 950 15th Street, Augusta GA 30901 is looking for sources capable of providing contractor furnished high-energy electro-hydraulic extra-corporeal shockwave medical equipment, consumables and technician(s) required to perform tendinopathy services to treat chronic musculoskeletal conditions to Veterans. Tendinopathy procedures can be performed unilaterally as well as bilaterally.
